items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: First name was Ken. I don’t know if it was Ken Burns.

ctx.x: Can you talk about your relationship with Oliver Nelson?

Yeah. Oliver did a lot of scoring here in Los Angeles for films and movies. As I can recall, I was called to play on maybe about four or five of them, along with – J. J. Johnson used to also do some writing here. As a result of meeting him here and playing on those recordings – in the films – he invited me to play on this project with Count Basie. But he also did another record. It’s something that Mayor Stokes from Cleveland – Mayor Stokes in Cleveland, Ohio, did a record. It was one of those oratories. Really,…
I asked you about Oliver Nelson.
